description: §6.7.7 `<#id>.refetch()` as a STATEMENT in a <program>-level function body re-executes the fetch (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). The request is mount-only (deps=[]); showSecond() writes @userId = 2 then calls <#userReq>.refetch() (the EC-7 write-then-refetch idiom). After the click @userData is user 2 ("b"). Pre-S444 the block splitter cut the function at the `<#`: the function emitted EMPTY and the rest of its source shipped into <body> as page text.
rationale: §6.7.7 Properties: "`<#id>.refetch()` | `() -> void` | Imperatively re-execute the fetch body"; EC-7: "Developers write directly to the `@variable` before calling `refetch()`." g-request-refetch-statement-dropped (S444).
